name: KTUI
summary: Tailwind CSS UI component library in plain JavaScript, initialized with data attributes.
description: Open-source, modular JavaScript/TypeScript UI library for Tailwind CSS projects: 40+ DOM-based components including DataTable, Select, Modal, Drawer, Tabs, Toast and Tooltip, themed with shadcn-like CSS variables and initialized through data attributes instead of JavaScript. Supports dark mode, RTL and custom fonts, and ships agent skills so coding assistants use it correctly.
contains: DOM-based JavaScript components for Tailwind CSS, no framework required
data-attribute initialization, zero JavaScript init code
components incl. DataTable, Select, Modal, Drawer, Tabs, Toast, Carousel, Progress
shadcn-like CSS variables for theming; dark mode and RTL support
ships 4 agent skills: ktui, ktui-install, ktui-datatable, ktui-select
